public static AcceptedFrame fromFrame(SFMTerminalFrame frame) {
        SFMTerminalFrameMetadata metadata = frame.metadata();
        return new AcceptedFrame(
                frame.sequence(),
                frame.streamIdentity(),
                metadata.logicalColumns(),
                metadata.logicalRows(),
                metadata.targetPanelWidth(),
                metadata.targetPanelHeight(),
                metadata.cellWidth(),
                metadata.cellHeight(),
                metadata.fontPixelSize(),
                metadata.rendererId(),
                metadata.transportId(),
                frame.payload().length,
                metadata.correlationId());
    }

actual_consumer_evidence.contract: Genuine lock-consistent connection observations, typed tuning/rejection, negotiated presentation selectors/state/diagnostics. Their implementations are pending and not supplied by this pure cohort.
Real requestRenderer/requestTransport typed result and renderer/transport ID call sites; existing terminal_presentation_actions already requires client_actions, workspace_panels and terminal_remote.
Real typed tuning/settings/rejection and properties diagnostics call sites. Existing action prerequisites unchanged; no wholesale panel/UI promotion.
Pure resource-state decisions, counters and retained heap compositor consumed by genuine pending GL presenters; no NativeImage/GL implementation staged.
Portable openSession contract and bounded scrollback/line contracts; local process/file backend is excluded.

preserved_pure_contracts: ConnectionSnapshot requires a non-null Optional but does not claim an atomic observation unless the real backend captures all fields under its transport lock.

PresentationCatalog retains unknown ID rejection, server-owned rasterization, exact transport/frame contract versions, top-left/straight/sRGB validation, bounded advertised dimensions and exact tuple matching.
Renderer/transport identities, requested-versus-active state and unavailable reasons remain original; class presence does not advertise a usable backend.
Tuning retains zero-as-auto, exact step sizes/ranges, checked add/subtract and structured typed rejection without changing connection health.
Raster validation retains overflow-checked dimensions/stride/ranges, complete contiguous dirty payload, ordered non-overlapping regions and negotiated region/byte bounds.

Heap compositor rejects stale generations before raster application; validates before replacement, requires full resync for new generation/dimension changes, exact dirty base sequence and copies retained pixels on access.
PNG resource state only records allocation/reuse/replace/close decisions. It does not allocate or close Minecraft/GL resources.
Telemetry retains synchronized bounded in-memory saturating counters; no file, process, network or generated Vox API.
Scrollback keeps bounded retained rows/colors, stable viewed row when output arrives, immutable visible lists and revision snapshots.
